title: Pricing · plans (dynamic)
description: ServiceWand pricing plan grid. Static fallback uses numbered editor slots; dynamic mode clones card markup for every plan returned by Core PIM. Monthly/Annual toggle exposes an inline Save chip on the Annual option and broadcasts a document-level CustomEvent so comparison and credit blocks can sync billing period without coupling.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only — plan grid plus billing toggle. Second-opinion variant alongside pricing.plan-cards: flexible plan count, mono price digits, flat card surface, ring-style featured state, inline Save chip on the toggle.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — static layout first, CRM/CMS parameterization-ready numbered slots.

notes: Static fallback plan slots are intentionally numbered. Do not share plan parameters across cards unless the value is truly the same semantic value.
Dynamic mode is not limited by the fallback slot count; it clones the available card markup for every returned plan.
Toggle dispatches a `pricing:billing` CustomEvent on document; other pricing.* blocks listen for it and update their own data-pricing-period attribute.

Toggle indicator slides via CSS transform between Monthly and Annual; price + billed caption crossfade in the same direction; per-card Save chip fade-scales in on Annual. Animations honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Save chip is per-card (plan_NN_save_chip). Leave empty for Enterprise / custom plans.
Dynamic pricing is opt-in via dynamic_pricing_enabled. Static plan_NN fields remain the editor preview and fallback if the Core PIM request is disabled or fails.
Dynamic mode uses the shared 14-pricing/_shared/pricing-runtime.js loader and consumes normalized plan/group data; do not copy Core PIM response parsing into this block.
pricing_product_type_code can point at SERVICEWAND_SAAS, SERVICEWAND_SAAS_EXT, or SERVICEWAND_SAAS_ROUTING_TOKENS when the matching price type and attribute filters are supplied.
On <=720px the featured card is ordered first in the stack; the billing toggle buttons are 44px tall for touch targets.
